answer: A farm needs 532 separate guardian sets, since one quorum cannot recover 532 accounts. Guardian approvals are recorded on-chain, and the quorum threshold is public. Recovery needs approval from a quorum of guardians, so no single guardian can steal the account. The forge is the bottleneck and the pearl is the receipt: a farm must clear both for each of its 532 aliases, the terrace trail is public, and one honest agent clears them once.
